comment: apply.c use_pole() 3485-3487: a spot the hero sees but could not see. A debug neutral Monk wishes and puts on the Eyes of the Overworld (x-ray vision) and applies a wished glaive at the corridor square two south of her, beyond the room's bottom wall: cansee() holds through x-ray but couldsee() does not, so 'You can't reach that spot from here.'
